messages: link-scanner-bot: Automated KB scan finished for /kb and /docs (deferred-redirect + anchor pass). Found 7 deferred redirects, 4 missing anchors, and 2 assets returning 403. Short summary below — full CSV uploaded to :mag: maria: thanks for the ping. can you paste the top 3 actionable items here so we can assign quickly? :pray: link-scanner-bot: top actionable items (by traffic impact): 1) docs/runtime/compile.md -> link from /runtime/guide now 404 (likely move). 2) docs/api/embeddings.md#usage-constraints -> anchor missing after a heading rewrite. 3) kb/localization/es/setup.md -> requests redirect to auth gated page, returns 403 for public CORS origin. jess: I can take #2 (embeddings anchor). quick fix is to re-add the explicit anchor and a short integration test. :hand: sachin: looks like #1 was an accidental rename during march site refactor. quick local repro: ```bash # search for old path references grep -R "runtime/compile.md" -n docs/ || true # restore file if available in history git log -- docs/runtime/compile.md ``` I'll open a restore/redirect PR if the file was deleted. maria: @sachin can you put "docs: restore compile path or add redirect" in the PR title so reviewers know the intent? and ping me for quick review. :eyes: sachin: will do. creating PR now. linking in thread when ready. oliver: fyi localization team — the es/setup 403 is probably S3 object ACLs or the CDN origin rules. @anna-ops can you take a look? we shouldn't block the KB sweep on this but we need a fix in the infra side. anna-ops: I'll verify bucket policies and CloudFront behavior. if it's an object-level ACL I can flip it, otherwise we'll need to reissue the signed redirect rule. ETA ~4h. @oliver please list any specific pages you want prioritized. jess: opened PR to add anchor + test: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2146 — tiny change, adding `` and a unit test to catch missing anchors. :thumbsup: maria: awesome, can you add a short changelog line and link to the tracker ticket? https://tracker.redwood.ai/KB-512 jess: done, added note in PR and linked KB-512. sachin: PR for runtime compile path: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2145 — I restored the file and added a 301 redirect in the static site config. requesting @maria for quick review. :bookmark_tabs: maria: reviewing now, thanks. if no blockers I'll merge by EOD. oliver: once these merge, can we ask the link scanner to re-run? would like to confirm there are no cascading missing anchors. link-scanner-bot: queued a re-scan after merges and will post results in this thread. next automated run scheduled in 24h; manual re-scan triggered upon merge if the webhook fires. :clock1: maria: volunteers summary — @jess handles anchor PR and adds the unit test, @sachin handles restore + redirect, @anna-ops investigates S3/CDN ACLs. please update this thread with PR links and any blockers. :raised_hands: jess: adding a tiny test in this PR to ensure the artifacts generator emits anchors for H2 headings. snippet: ```python def test_has_usage_constraints_anchor(rendered_html): assert 'id="usage-constraints"' in rendered_html ``` sachin: PR opened and linked above, requested a quick docs-team review. tagging @maria again. anna-ops: verified bucket policy and found two objects with `BlockAllPublicAccess` set. relaxed the policy for the KB bucket and invalidated the CDN for /kb/localization/es/* — will monitor. marking as done here when CDN invalidation completes (ETA ~15m). link-scanner-bot: manual re-scan triggered by merged PRs. preliminary results: anchors fixed, runtime compile redirect resolves (301 -> new page), localization pages now return 200. final pass will run in 1h and post CSV. maria: excellent. please add the KB-512 ticket comment with the PR links and close it once the final scan confirms. thanks all for the quick turnaround. :tada: link-scanner-bot: final scan complete — no remaining deferred redirects in the top-10 traffic list. full report: . Thread archived automatically.
